title: Blueberry Crumb Bars
ldIngredientsRaw: 15 oz all purpose flour (3 cups, see note)
ldInstructionsRaw: Preheat the oven to 350°F. Generously butter a 13" x 9" pan. Line the pan with parchment paper and allow it to hand over the sides for easier removal of the bars.

Combine 15 oz all purpose flour, 5 oz Stone ground cornmeal, ½ teaspoon baking soda, ½ teaspoon table salt, ½ teaspoon cinnamon, 8 oz brown sugar, 4 oz granulated sugar, 1 teaspoon vanilla extract and finely grated zest from 1 lemon in a large mixing bowl or in the bowl of a food processor. Mix to combine the ingredients or pulse a few times in the processor.

Toss in 12 oz unsalted butter and mix with your fingers until the butter bits are no larger than a pea and the dough clumps together when squeezed. If working in a food processor, run until the butter is fully combined and the dough begins to form clumps.
Reserve ⅓ of the dough for the topping. Sprinkle the remaining ⅔ of the dough into the pan and and lightly press into an even layer.
Bake 10-15 minutes until set and beginning to brown.
While the crust bakes, make the filling. In a large bowl, toss together 18 oz blueberries, 3 oz granulated sugar, 1 tablespoon cornstarch, juice of 1 lemon and salt.
Sprinkle the blueberries over the pre-baked crust and crumble the remaining dough over the berries.
Bake until golden brown and the berries are soft, about 25-30 minutes. Cool completely and cut into 24 bars.
